text:
To find the day of the week 567 days after Saturday, 2009-09-19, I need to determine how many complete weeks plus extra days are in 567 days.

567 ÷ 7 = 81 remainder 0

Since 567 is exactly divisible by 7 (567 = 81 × 7), there are 81 complete weeks with no extra days.

This means 567 days later brings us back to the same day of the week as the starting date.

**Saturday**
